name: airbnb_hedonic_pricing
what_it_holds: Committed CSVs: a listings file enriched with distance-to-nearest-subway-station (geocoded) and pororo_scoring.csv (Korean NLP sentiment scores computed over listing reviews). Hedonic feature set includes guest capacity, bed count, bathrooms, average rating, review volume, superhost status, ID verification, host response rate, deposit/cleaning fee, security camera, washer, free parking, photo count, plus the review-sentiment score and subway distance as location/quality proxies.
why_useful: A working example of turning review text into a quantitative listing-quality feature (sentiment score) combined with a hedonic regression -- directly relevant methodology for isolating a 'listing quality' or superhost premium net of location, which our mix-decomposition / ADR work needs a comparable technique for, even though the city (Seoul) is not one we track.
size_hint: small, single-city snapshot, unknown row count, 0 stars
time_coverage: unknown, appears to be a single scrape (repo last updated Dec 2022)
themes: Airbnb and hotel price-elasticity, hedonic and mix-decomposition studies with data (bedroom counts, listing quality, superhost premium)
